tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, header, inputs. Sits on bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and headings on bg, surface and tint.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and surface. Passes 4.5:1 on both.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card borders, section dividers. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders of controls: secondary button, unvoted vote button, inputs, filter chips. 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand green. Primary button, voted state, links, the Start half of the wordmark, focus ring.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for links and primary surfaces; number badges on tint.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Yellow spark. Small fills only: the dot in the icon, avatar fills, one highlight per screen. Never text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent and on avatar fills.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Quiet green fill: tags, active nav item, number badges, thumbnail grounds. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-width call-to-action band.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on band.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of success chips (Lansat, Terminată, În desfășurare).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on success-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of deadline and warning chips.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on warning-bg.
